ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  5paisa Capital Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Ameya Agnihotri, its Whole-Time Director and Chief Technology Officer (CTO), effective September 30, 2026, citing a desire to pursue external career opportunities. This constitutes a material loss of senior leadership and a critical technology role, potentially impacting the company's strategic technological direction and operational continuity. No immediate successor or transition plan is detailed in the announcement.
